protocol.design: Retrospective transfer stress test. All hospitals informed previous pooled development.
protocol.endpoint: num 0 -> 0, num 1..4 -> 1; keep unmodified ID, site and original target as metadata only
protocol.duplicate_policy: Normalized full 13-predictor groups before recoding. Keep complete validation site and purge its overlapping groups from fitting at both inner and outer levels.
protocol.fit: Phase 3 selections are fixed. No new search. Fit fresh Phase 2 median/standardization and categorical missing-token/one-hot pipeline on every permitted fitting partition. Fit final pipeline on three training hospitals.
protocol.inner: Three leave-one-training-hospital-out folds, train on two sites each. Concatenate predictions in training row order; observation-weighted threshold and sigmoid fit. Fail if a fitting fold lacks either class.
protocol.threshold: Maximize balanced accuracy on raw training OOF probabilities; inclusive cuts 0.20 to 0.80 by 0.05; ties closest to 0.50 then lower. Map locked cutoff through the positive-slope sigmoid for calibrated classifications, preserving operating point.
protocol.calibration: Compare raw and sigmoid for every model and policy. Fit logistic regression C=1, lbfgs, tol=1e-8, max_iter=2000 to training OOF log odds clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6] in probability space. Require >=20 examples of each class, varying OOF scores and strictly positive fitted slope; otherwise mark unavailable. Never choose a method by outer scores.
protocol.diagnostics: Five fixed equal-width reliability bins with counts, mean probability and observed fraction. Calibration-in-the-large intercept with offset logit(p); free-intercept unpenalized logistic slope if both classes, score variation and overlap. Flag sparse class (<20). Diagnostic regressions do not update predictions.
protocol.sensitivity: For paired cases compare mean absolute probability change, changed decisions, delta BA, AUC, Brier and log loss. Descriptive flag if mean absolute probability shift >=0.05 or absolute BA shift >=0.05. No policy selection.
protocol.aggregation: Per site first. Equal-site and record-count-weighted means of site metrics; report contributing sites. No pooling of probabilities across fitted models.

uncertainty.method: Within each held-out site sample whole predictor groups uniformly with replacement; common draws across configurations. Percentile 95% bounds for BA, sensitivity, specificity, AUROC, omitting replicates where that metric is undefined. Paired BA differences for extended LR minus early LR and early XGBoost minus early LR under raw/as-recorded. Conditional on fitted models. No multiplicity adjustment.

protocol.failure_analysis: Pairwise thresholded model disagreement in each tier; FP and FN and errors at p>=0.9 or p<=0.1. Compare named site prevalence, missingness and cholesterol zeros. Descriptive unless paired conditional intervals support a difference.
protocol.report_precision: six decimals JSON; three decimals tables; full precision throughout calculation
